state.objective: Diagnose 5-second latency spikes in Go service running on Alpine Linux.

context.content: musl libc resolver in Alpine does not support `options single-request-reopen`; concurrent A and AAAA queries with same source port cause conntrack drop in Linux kernel NAT

nameserver 10.96.0.10
search default.svc.cluster.local svc.cluster.local cluster.local
options ndots:5

submitted_answer.answer: The spikes are caused by musl parallel A/AAAA DNS queries reusing a source port, triggering Linux conntrack NAT drops and 5-second resolver retries.
